quality.review_scope: Independent scoped quick audit accepted main PDF pp.1–10 and SI Table S1 p.1, with Figures 1–10 visually checked and their sample links reviewed. The cited ref 45 Ag-nanocrystal reduction is not reconstructed; remaining SI pages and unresolved source conflicts are outside the accepted executable scope.
missing_fields: Original Ag NC reduction details remain in cited ref 45 and are not reproduced; stock formation is not executable from this paper alone.
SI Table S1 ligand amount heading prints mL for values 500/1000; physical unit is unresolved and those numbers must not be dosed.
PPh3-saturated hexane concentration, deposition parameters for disputed Figure 9C/D and Figure 10, and precise LCEM solvent mixing basis are unreported or conflicted.
Exact source-product atomic coordinates and cross-section deposition solvent are absent.
conflicts: Figure 3 Results prose says C10Ag5nm in toluene, but Figure 3 caption says 5 nm dodecanethiol-coated (C12) Ag NCs.

Figure 9 wash/readdition comparison uses Method 1 versus stated Method 2, so deposition method is a confounder; Figure 10 prose says Method 1, but its caption describes anticapillary tweezers (Method 2).
Figure 10 Results prose calls EDS area 2 Figure 9C, while Figure 10 image/caption place it in Figure 10C.
SI Table S1 ligand amount heading is printed as mL for 500/1000, inconsistent with practical interpretation; no correction asserted.

Unresolved LCEM solvent-scope conflict: Experimental Methods p.3 / printed p.4382 names toluene and a toluene/hexane mixture, whereas Results p.5 / printed p.4384 and the Figure 5 caption p.6 / printed p.4385 assign the Figure 5 C12Ag6nm observation to pure hexane. Figure 5 remains source-linked to hexane; no separate pure-toluene measured outcome is inferred.
